g.text: Validators' Staking Periods and AVAX Supply, Values at the Origin of 18 November 2025

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Open Sans', 'Noto Sans', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #4f545c

g.text: Traced from the client code of model v0.8.0. Filled boxes carry over from day to day, thick arrows move periods or AVAX,

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Open Sans', 'Noto Sans', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #4f545c

g.text: and dashed arrows carry what a step reads. The response to the reward rate is swept from 0 to 0.1 per percentage point

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Open Sans', 'Noto Sans', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #4f545c

g.text: of the 30-day reward rate a year, in log-odds of renewal and in log arrivals, and was first measured on 28 October 2026

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Open Sans', 'Noto Sans', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #4f545c

g.text: at about 0.025 for renewal and 0.04 for entry.
